item.title: Ask HN: Sane casual family co-op game on mobile?
item.summary: Are there any casual games suitable for a father to play remote co-op with a 10 yrs old son that is possible to buy for a reasonable price? Looking at this industry reveals a wasteland of dark patterns, data harvesting, exorbitant recurring fees, reviews with crashing servers, etc. I feel like I should be drowning in choices but after hours of searching I can't find a single game not leaving a bad taste in my mouth.
